conditions.runtime: The item is offered through the public JEM market purchase catalog.

change.summary: Deny public-market purchases for every tagged ore and mineral form while preserving eligible player sales.

modifiers.before: Reviewed two-way policies could expose ores, raw materials, ingots, nuggets, gems, dusts and storage blocks for public purchase.
modifiers.after: Any installed item or block in the Forge/Common ore, raw-material, ingot, nugget, gem, dust or storage-block families remains listed under its reviewed sale policy, but the market sends buyAvailable=false and the client disables its Buy button. Selling remains available.

rationale.purpose: Prevent the public market from replacing resource gathering across vanilla and installed mods.
rationale.decision_source: User clarified that no ore type, its ingots, pieces or blocks may be purchased, not only the initially listed vanilla examples. Codex maps that product rule to the installed Forge/Common tag families and preserves existing sell-side policy.

introduced.summary: Project eligible mineral policies as sell-only so their Buy button is disabled while their Sell action remains available.

history.summary: Apply one tag-driven rule to vanilla and modded mineral forms without enumerating item IDs, retaining sale listings and disabling only purchase.

relations: Existing sell policy -> retained sell-only listing and enabled Sell button
notes: Villager offers, player shops, gifts and barter retain their existing independent policy owners.
unresolved: Player-visible market acceptance remains pending the user's first session with the released artifact.
